mapper.sql: r.reservation_id, r.reservation_date, r.start_time, r.end_time, r.meeting_topic, r.attendance, r.reservation_status, r.created_at, r.updated_at, u.user_id AS u_user_id, u.user_name AS u_user_name, u.password AS u_password, u.role AS u_role, u.phone AS u_phone, mr.room_id AS m_room_id, mr.room_name AS m_room_name, mr.room_number AS m_room_number, mr.building AS m_building, mr.capacity AS m_capacity, mr.area AS m_area, mr.description AS m_description, mr.photo_url AS m_photo_url, mr.qr_code_url AS m_qr_code_url, mr.is_available AS m_is_available
FROM reservation r JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = r.user_id JOIN meeting_room mr ON mr.room_id = r.room_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (user_id, room_id, reservation_date, start_time, end_time, meeting_topic, attendance, reservation_status) VALUES (#{user.userId}, #{meetingRoom.roomId}, #{reservationDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{meetingTopic}, #{attendance}, #{status,typeHandler=com.meetingroom.typehandler.ReservationStatusTypeHandler})
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET reservation_status = #{status,typeHandler=com.meetingroom.typehandler.ReservationStatusTypeHandler}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId}
